name: refine-ablation
description: U1/U2/U3/U5 materialized: coordinate descent over the quantized codes scored on the DECODED PIXELS instead of the coefficients. refine_obj=1 (OKLAB, no clipping model) is the control - the objective there is separable and independent rounding already minimizes it, so it should find nothing. refine_obj=0 (gamma sRGB) and 2 (clipped OKLAB) model the L clamp and the per-channel gamut clip, which is the only place the orthogonality argument fails. refine_dc adds the DC codes (U2), refine_scale adds the AC scale codes (U3, clipping pre-compensation). Every arm carries the PRE-adoption base explicitly (later keys win), so the refinement knobs are ablated against the signal path this round actually shipped. Without it the base inherits today's defaults and the 'fit2+near (prior best)' and 'L28@4C15@3' arms collapse onto the incumbent.
